verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Chargebee's API docs noting that item prices carry currencies and must match within a subscription. That implies per-currency price points exist, but only as a single thin mention. No evidence shows customers being billed in their local currency end-to-end, and nothing covers consolidated reporting or conversion into a home currency. Missing for 10: explicit multi-currency billing documentation, per-currency price point configuration docs, consolidated home-currency reporting or exchange-rate handling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency

citations.quote: An item price is compatible with a plan-item price if their currencies are the same.
